name: 93444 · Nipomo, CA
findings: ZIP 93444 (Nipomo) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93444 (Nipomo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93444 (Nipomo) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
